Pass the model's full eta vector.", #>         call. = FALSE #>       ) #>     } #>     e[i] #>   } #>  #>   ## ---- structural covariate references ---- #>   FOOD <- if (!is.null(dfrow$FOOD) && dfrow$FOOD != -99) dfrow$FOOD else 1   # reference level of the ";  Most common" branch #>  #>   ## ---- $PK (pruned) ---- #>   if (FOOD == 1) MATFOOD <- 1 #>   if (FOOD == 0) MATFOOD <- 1 + basethetas[6] #>   MATCOVTIME <- MATFOOD #>   TVCL <- basethetas[2] #>   TVV <- basethetas[3] #>   TVMAT <- basethetas[4] #>   MU_3 <- log(TVCL) #>   MU_4 <- log(TVV) #>   MU_5 <- log(TVMAT) #>   CL <- exp(MU_3 + (covthetas[1] + .eta(etas, 3)))   # FREM parameter 1: ETA(3) -> covthetas[1] + etas[3] #>   V <- exp(MU_4 + (covthetas[2] + .eta(etas, 4)))   # FREM parameter 2: ETA(4) -> covthetas[2] + etas[4] #>   MAT <- MATCOVTIME * exp(MU_5 + (covthetas[3] + .eta(etas, 5)))   # FREM parameter 3: ETA(5) -> covthetas[3] + etas[5] #>  #>   list( #>     CL = CL, #>     V = V, #>     MAT = MAT #>   ) #> }  # Same result, located by run number instead of a path: out2 <- createFREMParamFunction(   runno      = 31,   modDevDir  = system.file("extdata/SimNeb/", package = "PMXFrem"),   parameters = c("CL", "V", "MAT") ) #> Translated $PK of run31.mod for FREM: 3 FREM covariate parameter(s) (CL, V, MAT), 0 returned as-is; numSkipOm = 2, numNonFREMThetas = 7, 1 structural covariate(s). #>   FOOD reference 1 - reference level of the ";  Most common" branch stopifnot(identical(out$code, out2$code))
